text:
Maria: Heads up — we saw a ~38% spike in GPU spend last billing window and most of it is attributed to the SearchProd project but the owner tag shows SandboxTeam. Can infra/eng confirm whether this is a mis-tag or an actual cross-team usage?
Alex: @Maria I dug in — those runs are from a set of hyperparam sweeps we kicked off for relevance tuning. They were launched from a personal service account that didn't have the project tag set, so GCP exported them under the default label (SandboxTeam). :facepalm:
Maria: Ok, thanks. Can you give me the run IDs and rough $ estimate so finance can propose a ledger adjustment or internal re-bill? We need to keep Q2 budgets accurate.
Alex: Short list: run-2026-03-01A, run-2026-03-02B, run-2026-03-05C. Estimated charge: $12,400 (GPU hours + storage). I can export the exact usage + machine types tomorrow.
Sam: Tagging mismatch is the root cause. We should avoid ledger gymnastics if we can re-attribute via the billing export backfill. I can run a one-off query to re-map SA -> project tags and produce a CSV for finance.
Sam: Quick query I use (BigQuery):
```
SELECT project.id, sku.description, cost, labels.key, labels.value
FROM `company-billing.gcp_billing.export_v1_*`
WHERE service.description LIKE '%GPU%'
AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-07'
AND labels.value IN ('SandboxTeam')
```
Maria: That would help. If backfill is possible we prefer that to manual chargebacks. Does backfill change committed usage or just our internal view?
Sam: It changes our internal attribution only; cloud invoice stays the same. Finance can then apply an internal journal to shift_cost_center -> SearchPlatform.
Jess: FYI product — the Search team will likely want the costs credited to them (they ran the experiments). Approving a one-time journal entry is fine from product side as long as we have the exported evidence + run IDs.
billing-bot: AutomatedAlert: GPU usage spike detected for project "default-unlabeled" on 2026-03-05 — delta: +38% vs baseline. Link: https://billing.internal/alerts/17582
Maria: Two asks: (1) @Alex export the run logs and exact cost lines by EOD Thursday, (2) @Sam run the backfill mapping and produce CSV + SQL we can attach to the journal. I'll prepare a draft internal journal entry for approval.
Alex: Will do. Also noting some runs used pre-purchased reservation credits — unclear if those credits were attached to SandboxTeam or SearchPlatform. I'll mark that in the export.
Sam: If credits are implicated we may need SRE to reassign the reservation. If it's just labels we can backfill and move on.
Maria: Can we get an approval window? I'll post the draft journal to #finance-approvals when ready and tag @Jess for product sign-off. If no objections within 48h we execute.
Jess: +1 from product. Please include the experiment owner and expected impact to SearchPlatform budget this quarter.
Alex: Adding the owner: @dana_search (experiment lead). Adding rough impact: +$12.4k to SearchPlatform Q2 spend.
Maria: Thanks. Assigning tasks: Alex -> export CSV of runs + credit attribution; Sam -> backfill query & mapping CSV; Maria -> draft journal & submit for sign-off.
Sam: I'll put the backfill script in infra repo under ops/billing/backfill_2026_03.sh and run it in staging first. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Perfect. Once we have CSV evidence we'll either backfill attribution or apply the journal. Keep me posted if you hit blockers. :eyes:
Alex: Sharing preliminary CSV in thread tomorrow.
Jess: Thanks all.
Maria: Closing loop — if we need to change tagging enforcement, let's make a small policy (require project tag on all service accounts) and flag to devex to roll out a guardrail.
Sam: I'll add an infra lint rule to our onboarding script.
Maria: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
